pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED PATTERNS (PostgreSQL, last 48h):

PATTERN 1: Trail vs SL families are perfectly bimodal.
- TRAIL_FAMILY: n=17, 16W/1L, 94.1% WR, +2.31 USDT, avg hold 2.0h
- SL_FAMILY: n=26, 0W/26L, 0% WR, -1.93 USDT, avg hold 0.7h
- WINNING SIDE: enter in a trend, let the trail ride it. WHY WE MISS IT: we enter during chop (no momentum), price stalls, SL hits. The entry timing is the problem, not the exit.

PATTERN 2: RSI 45-60 LONG band is a death zone right now.
- RSI 45-60 LONG: n=12, 2W/10L, 16.7% WR, -0.05 avg
- RSI>60 LONG: n=15, 7W/8L, 46.7% WR, +0.06 avg
- WINNING SIDE: momentum longs (RSI>60). WHY WE MISS IT: the AI trader and signal filters push RSI 45-60 as 'center of band' — but in this regime, mid-RSI means no momentum, and no momentum means chop. RSI>60 means the move already started.

PATTERN 3: SHORTS bleeding in LONG_BIAS regime.
- SHORTS 48h: n=17, 5W/12L, 29.4% WR, -0.34 USDT
- WINNING SIDE: longs (37.5% WR but +0.40 net — winners bigger). WHY WE MISS IT: short signals fire on any red candle, but BTC 15m/4h are both LONG_BIAS. Fighting the higher-timeframe tilt.

PATTERN 4: BTC specifically is a chop coin this week.
- BTC last 10 trades: 2 trail wins, 6 SL losses, 2 flat. Avg hold on losses 1.6h. BTC needs a real trend to pay — current STRONG_DOWN trend_quality + LOW volume = no edge. Avoid BTC until continuum shows STRONG trend direction.
